{{wiktionarypar|episcopal|Episcopal|episcopalian}}

'''Episcopal''' may refer to:

*[[Bishop]], an overseer in the Christian church
*[[Diocese|Episcopate]], the see of a bishop, a diocese
*[[Episcopal polity]], the church united under the oversight of bishops
*[[Episcopal Church]], any church with "Episcopal" in its name

==Usage==
''Episcopal'' describes a church governed by bishops; ''episcopalian'' is a member of an episcopal church.

==See also==
*[[Historical episcopate]], dioceses established according to apostolic succession
*[[Episcopal Conference]], an official assembly of bishops in a territory of the Roman Catholic Church

{{disambig}}

[[simple:Episcopalian]]
